mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xsy_trace_unit (unit_code, public_token, lot_id, package_type, quantity, unit, status, remark, created_by, net_weight, weight_unit, weight_source, weighing_event_id, measured_at) VALUES (#{unitCode}, #{publicToken}, #{lotId}, #{packageType}, #{quantity}, #{unit}, 'ACTIVE', #{remark}, #{createdBy}, #{netWeight}, #{weightUnit}, #{weightSource}, #{weighingEventId}, #{measuredAt})

INSERT INTO xsy_trace_event (unit_id, lot_id, event_type, source_document_type, source_document_id, occurred_at, operator, remark, created_by) VALUES (#{unitId}, #{lotId}, 'ISSUE', NULL, NULL, #{occurredAt}, #{operator}, #{remark}, #{operator})
mapper.select: SELECT t.id AS lotId, t.lot_no AS lotNo, t.source_lot_no AS sourceLotNo, t.sku_id AS skuId, k.spu_id AS spuId, p.name AS spuName, k.sku_code AS skuCode, k.spec_name AS skuName FROM xsy_trace_lot t LEFT JOIN xsy_product_sku k ON k.id = t.sku_id LEFT JOIN xsy_product_spu p ON p.id = k.spu_id WHERE t.id = #{lotId}
SELECT unit FROM xsy_inventory_lot_balance WHERE lot_id = #{lotId} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, quantity FROM xsy_inventory_lot_balance WHERE lot_id = #{lotId} ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE

SELECT r.warehouse_id FROM xsy_purchase_receipt_item_lot l JOIN xsy_purchase_receipt_item i ON i.id = l.purchase_receipt_item_id JOIN xsy_purchase_receipt r ON r.id = i.purchase_receipt_id WHERE l.lot_id = #{lotId} AND r.deleted = FALSE ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT u.id, u.unit_code AS unitCode, u.public_token AS publicToken, u.lot_id AS lotId, t.lot_no AS lotNo, t.source_lot_no AS sourceLotNo, u.package_type AS packageType, u.quantity, u.unit, u.net_weight AS netWeight, u.weight_unit AS weightUnit, u.weight_source AS weightSource, u.measured_at AS measuredAt, u.status, u.remark, u.created_at AS createdAt, u.created_by AS createdBy FROM xsy_trace_unit u LEFT JOIN xsy_trace_lot t ON t.id = u.lot_id WHERE u.unit_code = #{unitCode}

SELECT u.id, u.unit_code AS unitCode, u.public_token AS publicToken, u.lot_id AS lotId, t.lot_no AS lotNo, t.source_lot_no AS sourceLotNo, u.package_type AS packageType, u.quantity, u.unit, u.net_weight AS netWeight, u.weight_unit AS weightUnit, u.weight_source AS weightSource, u.measured_at AS measuredAt, u.status, u.remark, u.created_at AS createdAt, u.created_by AS createdBy FROM xsy_trace_unit u LEFT JOIN xsy_trace_lot t ON t.id = u.lot_id WHERE u.unit_code = #{unitCode} FOR UPDATE OF u

SELECT u.id, u.unit_code AS unitCode, u.public_token AS publicToken, u.lot_id AS lotId, t.lot_no AS lotNo, t.source_lot_no AS sourceLotNo, u.package_type AS packageType, u.quantity, u.unit, u.net_weight AS netWeight, u.weight_unit AS weightUnit, u.weight_source AS weightSource, u.measured_at AS measuredAt, u.status, u.remark, u.created_at AS createdAt, u.created_by AS createdBy FROM xsy_trace_unit u LEFT JOIN xsy_trace_lot t ON t.id = u.lot_id WHERE u.public_token = #{publicToken}

SELECT u.id, u.unit_code AS unitCode, u.public_token AS publicToken, u.lot_id AS lotId, t.lot_no AS lotNo, t.source_lot_no AS sourceLotNo, u.package_type AS packageType, u.quantity, u.unit, u.net_weight AS netWeight, u.weight_unit AS weightUnit, u.weight_source AS weightSource, u.measured_at AS measuredAt, u.status, u.remark, u.created_at AS createdAt, u.created_by AS createdBy FROM xsy_trace_unit u LEFT JOIN xsy_trace_lot t ON t.id = u.lot_id WHERE u.id = #{id}
SELECT u.id, u.unit_code AS unitCode, u.lot_id AS lotId, u.quantity, u.unit, u.status, u.created_at AS createdAt FROM xsy_trace_unit u WHERE u.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE OF u

SELECT r.receipt_no AS receiptNo, r.supplier_name_snapshot AS supplierName, r.confirmed_at AS confirmedAt FROM xsy_purchase_receipt_item_lot l JOIN xsy_purchase_receipt_item i ON i.id = l.purchase_receipt_item_id JOIN xsy_purchase_receipt r ON r.id = i.purchase_receipt_id WHERE l.lot_id = #{lotId} AND r.deleted = FALSE ORDER BY r.confirmed_at DESC NULLS LAST, r.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT i.task_id AS taskId, i.id AS itemId, i.sku_id AS skuId, i.sales_order_id AS salesOrderId, i.sales_order_item_id AS salesOrderItemId, i.customer_id AS customerId, i.customer_name_snapshot AS customerName, i.order_no_snapshot AS orderNo, i.sorted_quantity AS sortedQuantity, i.sale_unit_snapshot AS saleUnit, oi.mall_stock_unit_snapshot AS stockUnit, oi.mall_stock_units_per_sale_unit AS stockUnitsPerSaleUnit, t.status AS taskStatus, t.warehouse_id AS warehouseId FROM xsy_sorting_task_item i JOIN xsy_sorting_task t ON t.id = i.task_id LEFT JOIN xsy_sales_order_item oi ON oi.id = i.sales_order_item_id WHERE i.id = #{itemId} AND i.deleted = FALSE FOR UPDATE OF i

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(u.quantity), 0) FROM xsy_trace_unit_binding b JOIN xsy_trace_unit u ON u.id = b.unit_id WHERE b.sorting_task_item_id = #{itemId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM xsy_trace_unit_unbind ub WHERE ub.binding_id = b.id)

SELECT count(*) FROM xsy_sorting_task_item i JOIN xsy_inventory_outbound_item oi ON oi.sales_order_item_id = i.sales_order_item_id JOIN xsy_inventory_outbound o ON o.id = oi.outbound_id WHERE i.id = #{itemId} AND (o.status = 'CONFIRMED' OR o.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xsy_trace_unit_binding (unit_id, lot_id, sorting_task_id, sorting_task_item_id, sales_order_id, sales_order_item_id, customer_id, customer_name_snapshot, order_no_snapshot, bound_at, bound_by, created_by) VALUES (#{unitId}, #{lotId}, #{taskId}, #{itemId}, #{salesOrderId}, #{salesOrderItemId}, #{customerId}, #{customerName}, #{orderNo}, #{boundAt}, #{operator}, #{operator})

INSERT INTO xsy_trace_event (unit_id, lot_id, event_type, source_document_type, source_document_id, occurred_at, operator, created_by) VALUES (#{unitId}, #{lotId}, 'BIND', 'SORTING_TASK_ITEM', #{itemId}, #{occurredAt}, #{operator}, #{operator})
mapper.update: UPDATE xsy_trace_unit SET status = 'VOID' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xsy_trace_event (unit_id, lot_id, event_type, occurred_at, operator, remark, created_by) VALUES (#{unitId}, #{lotId}, 'VOID', #{occurredAt}, #{operator}, #{reason}, #{operator})
INSERT INTO xsy_trace_event (unit_id, lot_id, event_type, occurred_at, operator, remark, created_by) VALUES (#{unitId}, #{lotId}, 'WEIGH', #{occurredAt}, #{operator}, #{remark}, #{operator})
mapper.select: SELECT b.id FROM xsy_trace_unit_binding b WHERE b.unit_id = #{unitId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM xsy_trace_unit_unbind u WHERE u.binding_id = b.id) ORDER BY b.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT b.sorting_task_id AS sortingTaskId, b.sorting_task_item_id AS sortingTaskItemId, b.order_no_snapshot AS orderNo, b.customer_name_snapshot AS customerName, b.bound_at AS boundAt, b.bound_by AS boundBy FROM xsy_trace_unit_binding b WHERE b.unit_id = #{unitId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM xsy_trace_unit_unbind u WHERE u.binding_id = b.id)

SELECT o.outbound_no AS outboundNo, m.occurred_at AS occurredAt, SUM(-m.quantity) AS quantity FROM xsy_inventory_lot_movement m JOIN xsy_inventory_outbound o ON o.id = m.source_document_id WHERE m.lot_id = #{lotId} AND m.movement_type = 'SALES_OUT' GROUP BY o.outbound_no, m.occurred_at ORDER BY m.occurred_at DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT i.task_id AS taskId, i.id AS itemId, i.sku_id AS skuId, i.sales_order_id AS salesOrderId, i.sales_order_item_id AS salesOrderItemId, i.customer_id AS customerId, i.customer_name_snapshot AS customerName, i.order_no_snapshot AS orderNo, i.sorted_quantity AS sortedQuantity, i.sale_unit_snapshot AS saleUnit, oi.mall_stock_unit_snapshot AS stockUnit, oi.mall_stock_units_per_sale_unit AS stockUnitsPerSaleUnit, t.status AS taskStatus, t.warehouse_id AS warehouseId FROM xsy_sorting_task_item i JOIN xsy_sorting_task t ON t.id = i.task_id LEFT JOIN xsy_sales_order_item oi ON oi.id = i.sales_order_item_id WHERE i.id = #{itemId} AND i.deleted = FALSE

SELECT l.id AS lotId, l.lot_no AS lotNo, l.source_lot_no AS sourceLotNo, b.unit AS unit, SUM(b.quantity) AS balance FROM xsy_trace_lot l JOIN xsy_inventory_lot_balance b ON b.lot_id = l.id WHERE b.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND l.sku_id = #{skuId} GROUP BY l.id, l.lot_no, l.source_lot_no, b.unit HAVING SUM(b.quantity) > 0 ORDER BY l.id
SELECT e.id, e.task_item_id AS taskItemId, e.net_weight AS netWeight, e.business_unit AS businessUnit, e.completion_id AS completionId FROM xsy_sorting_scale_event e WHERE e.id = #{eventId}

SELECT u.id, u.unit_code AS unitCode, u.public_token AS publicToken, u.lot_id AS lotId, t.lot_no AS lotNo, t.source_lot_no AS sourceLotNo, u.package_type AS packageType, u.quantity, u.unit, u.net_weight AS netWeight, u.weight_unit AS weightUnit, u.weight_source AS weightSource, u.measured_at AS measuredAt, u.status, u.remark, u.created_at AS createdAt, u.created_by AS createdBy FROM xsy_trace_unit u LEFT JOIN xsy_trace_lot t ON t.id = u.lot_id WHERE u.weighing_event_id = #{weighingEventId}

SELECT u.id, u.unit_code AS unitCode, u.public_token AS publicToken, u.lot_id AS lotId, u.package_type AS packageType, u.quantity, u.unit, u.net_weight AS netWeight, u.weight_unit AS weightUnit, u.status FROM xsy_trace_unit u JOIN xsy_sorting_scale_event e ON e.id = u.weighing_event_id WHERE e.task_item_id = #{itemId} AND e.completion_id = #{completionId} AND e.status = 'ACCEPTED' AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM xsy_trace_unit_binding b WHERE b.unit_id = u.id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM xsy_trace_unit_unbind ub WHERE ub.binding_id = b.id)) ORDER BY e.basket_no NULLS LAST, u.id
